note: First versioned engine: golden baselines for Northbeam (re-baselined after the prototype fixes, PRD §6.8), Northbeam as seeded, and Larkspur Creative.

Rating model (issue #106): detected issues carry a four-level rating (great/good/bad/risk) instead of four severities, rated with the expected wait defaulting to 1 or 2 working days of the model's week; the golden outputs now lock every issue's rating and how it was reached. StepResult gains a p90 field; no simulated number changed.
Client groups (A55): clients can be counted per service and are simulated as unnamed clients; adds the northbeam-groups golden model. The existing golden models do not move.
